text_block_list.text:
One day during training, Biwa Hayahide
seems
rather preoccupied with her hand.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No, it's fine. I just ran out of hand cream.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I chose it specifically because the
ingredients are
perfect for my skin, but
there's a shortage right
now, so my
hands are rougher than usual.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What? Oh no, I'm fine! I'm sure my usual
hand
cream will be back in stock soon.
choice_data_list: 君にあうハンドクリームを探そうか？
貴方にあうハンドクリームを探そうか？
choice_data_list_en: Shall we find some hand cream that suits you?
Shall we look for a hand cream that suits you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Er, this has nothing to do with my
running, so you
don't have to check my
hands or anything, right?

Biwa Hayahide seems rather abashed by
the
condition of her skin.
